sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 151)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, Claudette Colbert and Don DeFore in *Without Reservations* alongside Helen Twelvetrees on *Lux Radio Theatre* for Lux Soap, William Conrad confronting frontier exploitation in Les Crutchfield's *Gunsmoke* for L&M, Sydney Smith solving a locked-office slaying in *The Adventures of Ellery Queen* for Anacin, and WWII Radio News commentaries (1935–1956):
